name: Museo Provincial de Granma Manuel Muñoz Cedeño
Museo Provincial Ignacio Agramonte
known: The provincial culture directorate lists the museum among its institutions on its official portal (Wayback copy, 2022).

ACN, relayed by OnCuba on 28 June 2020, named the Ignacio Agramonte museum among those serving the public in Camagüey after the pandemic closure and quoted Bélgica Perpiñán Colina, director of the Centro Provincial de Patrimonio Cultural, on the province's museums.
The Centro Provincial de Patrimonio Cultural's director spoke for the capital's museums, this one included (ACN via OnCuba, June 2020).

name: Teatro Tomás Terry
known: The building won the National Conservation Prize in 2008, and its staff received the Vanguardia Nacional distinction that year (EcuRed).

In 2022 it was one of three sub-venues outside Havana of the 27th Havana International Ballet Festival, its first large event after four years of restoration, according to director Miguel Cañellas Sueiras (5 de Septiembre).
The Cienfuegos culture portal lists the theatre with its director in its directory of institutions (2021).
Listed with its director, Miguel Cañellas Sueiras, in the Azurina culture portal's directory of Cienfuegos institutions (2021).
The Azurina culture portal lists its director, address and hours; it links no accounts.
The building won the National Conservation Prize in 2008.

name: Ballet Nacional de Cuba
known: Its archived site names Viengsay Valdés as director general.

name: Biblioteca Nacional de Cuba José Martí
known: Its first director, Domingo Figarola Caneda, donated its first books from his own collection (library site, EcuRed).

name: Casa Oswaldo Guayasamín
known: In 2024 the Office's deputy director said large companies still hand over their historic-centre profits to the Office; she named none, and her statement concerns the Office as a whole (Diario de Cuba).

name: Casa de las Américas
known: Haydée Santamaría was its first director (1959 to 1980).

name: Centro de Arte Contemporáneo Wifredo Lam
known: Brasil de Fato reported that the 15th edition was scheduled to run to 28 February 2025 under director Nelson Ramírez de Arellano.

name: Cinemateca de Cuba
known: OnCuba names Héctor García Mesa as founder.

The new house holds bibliographic and press collections and a growing set of DVD and Blu-ray copies, a small hall called El Mégano for screenings and talks, and a large patio (OnCuba, quoting director Luciano Castillo).

name: EGREM
known: Mario Escalona was general director when the Sony Music agreement was signed in 2015 (Havana Times) and was named as director general in December 2018 (OnCuba).

name: Estudio Figueroa-Vives
known: Private studio-gallery in the founders' home in the Vedado neighbourhood of Havana, Calle 21 No. 303, between H and I (studio site).
Founded on 9 October 1995 by the curator Cristina Vives and the photographer José A.
Their daughter, the curator Cristina Figueroa, also runs it (studio site, Havana Times).
Two of its curators have ties to other bodies: Cristina Vives and Cristina Figueroa are UNEAC members, and Figueroa also curates for Casa de las Américas (studio site).
Its curators belong to UNEAC, CIMAM and AICA;

name: Feria Internacional del Libro de La Habana
Festival Internacional del Nuevo Cine Latinoamericano de La Habana
Fototeca de Cuba
known: The 2025 edition was announced for 1 to 30 November under Fototeca director Lissette Solórzano, with venues beyond the Fototeca that included Fábrica de Arte Cubano and Factoría Habana (ACN claims).
